summary: Benchmarks have clawed back part of the afternoon slide heading into the last half-hour, though the index remains firmly in the red with selling pressure easing rather than reversing.

detail.leaders: Banks and NBFCs (SBI, HDFC Bank, Kotak)
detail.tone: A modest recovery since 2:30: Nifty is back around 22,650 per the latest headline after a 2 pm low of 22,578.25; Sensex is down about 400 pts versus 506 at 2 pm.
watch: Whether the bounce holds through the closing auction
Provisional FII/DII data after the close
